## Meta FY2024 Operating Margin

**Source data** (fiscal year ended December 31, 2024):
- Revenue: **$164,501 million** [DOC: meta_10k_fy2024.txt — CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME, "Fiscal year 2024: Revenue $164,501; Income from operations $69,380"]
- Income from operations: **$69,380 million** [DOC: meta_10k_fy2024.txt — CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME]

**Calculation:** $69,380 ÷ $164,501 = **42.2%**

**Comparability note:** The filing is Meta Platforms, Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (accession 0001326801-25-000017) [DOC: meta_10k_fy2024.txt]. FY2024 and the comparative FY2023/FY2022 periods are all 12-month calendar-year periods for the same consolidated entity on a consistent basis, so no adjustment for fiscal-year mismatch, divestiture, or segment redefinition is required. Note that the margin figure above is a derived metric (income from operations ÷ revenue), not a line item explicitly reported in the excerpt.

**Context:** FY2023 operating margin was $46,751 ÷ $134,902 = 34.7% [DOC: meta_10k_fy2024.txt — CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME, "Fiscal year 2023 (comparative): Revenue $134,902; Income from operations $46,751"], implying roughly a 7.5-percentage-point year-over-year expansion, driven by revenue growth (~21.9%) substantially outpacing growth in costs and expenses.

ANSWER: Approximately 42.2% ($69,380M income from operations ÷ $164,501M revenue)
